task.name: Three hundred equal circles in a circle
task.family: science frontier physics circles in circle
task.description: Place the centres of 300 equal, non-overlapping circles inside a circle of radius 1 so that their common radius is as large as possible. The best known packing, with radius 0.0531542991469, was found by Lai, Hao, Yue, Lü and Fu in 2021 and is not proven optimal.
task.contract: construct() -> array of shape (N, 2): centres of N equal circles inside the unit circle (radius 1, centred at the origin). Score: the largest common radius r = min(min_{i<j} |c_i - c_j| / 2, min_i (1 - |c_i|)) for which the circles are disjoint and inside the container, computed in double precision; maximize. A centre on or outside the container, coincident centres, a wrong shape or non-finite values make the candidate invalid.
